- **Backfilled win-count achievements from existing lifetime stats**: players who were racking up wins before achievements existed now get credit — 9 win-count achievements (Getting the Hang of It, Seasoned Player, Veteran, Legend, Regular, No Days Off, Good Sport, Social Butterfly, Deck Curator) are unlocked/progressed based on each player's pre-existing statistics, applied silently (no unlock notification spam for old progress).
- **Fixed "Watch Replay" being broken for every game**: the board title showed literal "undefined" text and the Players list crashed empty, because the replay view had never been updated with several fields (timeouts, time limits, synchronous mode, achievement trophy icons) added to the live board since Watch Replay first shipped. Both the in-app replay and the exported-game replay are fixed.
